lessonsIntro: Nolton Haven is a small, sheltered cove, and no surf school we found teaches here; the nearest lessons are at Newgale and Broad Haven on either side.

text: Nolton Haven is a small sand and shingle cove facing south-west into St Brides Bay, with cliffs on both sides. It's better known for rock pools, kayaking and family bathing than for surf, and none of the local schools list it as a lesson beach. If you want to learn, Newgale and Broad Haven sit either side of it on the same narrow coast road, and both are regular teaching beaches.

The RNLI patrols Nolton Haven daily in the summer holidays, 4 July to 6 September in 2026, 10am to 6pm. The National Park warns that currents can be unpredictable, especially at low tide, and Visit Pembrokeshire notes strong currents off the beach and a tide that comes in fast over the wide low-tide sand. If you do paddle out, stay inside the flagged zone and don't go alone.

cards.label: Level
cards.title: Not a lesson beach
cards.text: No school we found teaches here. Beginners are better off booking a lesson at nearby Newgale or Broad Haven.

cards.label: Best time
cards.title: Lifeguarded July to early September
cards.text: Lifeguards patrol daily through the summer holidays. Outside that, there's no cover.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: Currents and a fast tide
cards.text: Currents can be unpredictable, especially at low tide, and the tide comes in quickly across the wide beach.

hireIntro: There's no surf hire at Nolton Haven itself; the nearest hire is at Newgale and Broad Haven, either side of the cove.

text: Nolton Haven is a sheltered cove, so it's better suited to bodyboarding in small waves, paddleboarding or kayaking than to surfing. If you're bringing a board, a big soft-top is the safe choice for beginners, but most surfers head to Newgale for more reliable waves. A full wetsuit is needed all year, with boots, gloves and a hood in winter.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Soft-top or bodyboard
cards.text: Small waves in a sheltered cove suit a soft-top or bodyboard. For proper learning, go to Newgale or Broad Haven.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 4/3mm in summer, 5mm or more in winter
cards.text: Sea temperature data for the south Pembrokeshire coast suggests a 4/3 or 3/2 in mid-August and a 5/4 or thicker with boots, gloves and a hood around late February, when the water drops to roughly 7 to 9°C. Spring and autumn sit in between.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: Kayaks and paddleboards
cards.text: The National Park highlights Nolton Haven for launching kayaks, and there's a slipway. Offshore byelaws, including a speed limit, apply.

shopsIntro: Nolton Haven has no surf shop, but there are well-stocked shops in Newgale and Broad Haven nearby.
shopsText: Nolton Haven is a tiny hamlet with a pub and not much else, so pick up kit before you arrive. Newsurf sits on the beachfront at Newgale to the north, selling boards, accessories and clothing. To the south, Haven Sports in Broad Haven stocks wetsuits, surfboards, bodyboards and paddleboards. Both are on the coast road that runs past Nolton Haven.

lessons.q: Can I get surf lessons at Nolton Haven?
lessons.a: We couldn't find any school that teaches here. Newsurf at Newgale and schools using Broad Haven are the nearest options.

lessons.q: Is Nolton Haven good for beginners?
lessons.a: It's a sheltered, family-friendly cove, but it isn't a regular surf spot. Beginners will get more consistent waves and proper tuition at Newgale or Broad Haven.

lessons.q: Are there lifeguards at Nolton Haven?
lessons.a: Yes, in summer. The RNLI patrols daily from early July to early September, 10am to 6pm.

hire.q: Where can I hire a surfboard near Nolton Haven?
hire.a: Newsurf at Newgale hires soft boards, hard boards, bodyboards, SUPs and wetsuits. In Broad Haven, the RNLI says hire is available from the seafront watersports shop.

hire.q: Can I launch a kayak or SUP here?
hire.a: Yes. There's a slipway, and the National Park recommends Nolton Haven for launching kayaks. Watch for currents, especially at low tide.

shops.q: Is there a surf shop at Nolton Haven?
shops.a: No. The nearest are Newsurf at Newgale and Haven Sports in Broad Haven.
